_note: Desired OBS state. Settings only - no stream key, no tokens. Secrets stay out of this repo.
_applied: 2026-11-23, verified in OBS 33.0.3; output mode Advanced; current device settings are not imported from this file
_why: Local recording uses hardware AV1 constant-quality encoding; audio sources are isolated on two MKV tracks.

output._why: CQP quality is variable bitrate; the 40 Mbps internet plan does not constrain local recording.

mic.name: Microphone (Owl Lite Audio)
mic.why: Wired and always on. The Barracuda X mic auto-sleeps when idle and silently records -85 dB of nothing.
mic._filterOrder: Noise first so gain amplifies clean voice; limiter last so a shout cannot clip. Measured -31.5 LUFS before gain, ~-17.5 after.

desktopAudio.name: Speakers (Razer Barracuda X 2.4)
desktopAudio.why: Pinned instead of 'default', which followed Windows onto the Bluetooth speaker at 44.1 kHz with 100-300 ms latency.

scene._oneVoiceSourceOnly: There must be exactly one live microphone. The Owl Lite was once captured twice (own source + global Mic/Aux), which comb-filters it. Razer and Digitek capture sources stay muted for A/B.

twitch.note: hard ceiling for non-partners; 720p60 looks sharper than 1080p60 at this rate

streaming._uplink: 40 Mbps Airtel FTTH; stream bitrate is irrelevant to local recording. Streaming is not used.
